sloka: विदित्वा माम् महाबाहुः अमुत्र अपि महाबलः ।आनेष्यति पराक्रम्य वैवस्वत हृताम् अपि ॥३-४९-३५॥
transliteration: viditvā mām mahābāhuḥ amutra api mahābalaḥ ।āneṣyati parākramya vaivasvata hṛtām api ॥3-49-35॥

translations.english: Tell Rama that his dear wife Sita whom he loves more than his life is abducted helplessly.
